notes: This run's headline finding (Critical #1) is a bug the with-skill run completely missed: confirmResolution reads pending.recipient/pending.amount via a storage reference AFTER delete-ing that same slot, so every admin-confirmed resolution pays 0 wei to address(0) silently, permanently stranding funds. This was an accidental bug in the test fixture (not one of the 3 deliberately injected), and this run caught it with a precise, correct root-cause explanation of Solidity storage-reference aliasing -- a level of precision the with-skill run did not reach anywhere in its own review of this file.
